trello.name: Fix Android photo upload crash
trello.desc: Marcus to fix the NullPointerException in the media picker callback on Android 14 that occurs when a user backgrounds the app mid-upload. This is the top crasher affecting ~4% of Android sessions. Repro: start a photo upload, background the app before it finishes, come back. Fix must be landed and verified by Wednesday (first week of sprint) so QA has time before the August 20 mobile release.

trello.name: Verify Android crash fix on test devices
trello.desc: Sam to confirm Marcus's Android crash fix on Android 14 test devices once landed, and add it to the regression run.

trello.name: Build sync API for offline notes mode
trello.desc: Elena to build the backend sync API endpoint this sprint: client sends its last-synced timestamp and receives a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Conflict resolution is last-write-wins for now; no merge UI in this pass. Elena will have the sync API in review before she is out on the 17th and 18th.

trello.name: Implement client-side offline notes mode
trello.desc: Marcus to implement the client side of offline mode for the notes list: local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, replay them when connectivity returns. Acceptance criteria: user can open the app in airplane mode, see notes, edit them, and everything reconciles when back online with no data loss. Marcus to write these acceptance criteria into the ticket.

trello.name: Migrate CI pipelines to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Sam to migrate pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions. Proof of concept for the build job already exists. This sprint: finish the test and release pipelines, keep the nightly build schedule, and run both Jenkins and GitHub Actions systems in parallel for a week before turning Jenkins off. Jenkins must stay alive until the parallel week is clean (per Priya's approval condition).

trello.name: Add per-user rate limiting to search endpoint
trello.desc: Elena to add per-user rate limiting to the search endpoint, which was degraded by a misbehaving script last week. Requirements: 100 requests per minute per user, return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header beyond that limit, and add a metrics counter to track which users are hitting the limit.

trello.name: Update privacy policy screen for GDPR compliance
trello.desc: Marcus to update the privacy policy/consent screen so consent is opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, not a single pre-checked box. He will get the new copy from legal and rebuild the screen with opt-in toggles and nothing pre-checked. This is a launch blocker and must be in the August 20 release for the EU launch.

trello.name: Write regression tests for payments flow
trello.desc: Sam to write automated regression tests for the payments flow covering purchase, restore, cancellation, and the receipt validation path. Goal is to have them running in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline. This addresses the lack of automated coverage that caused issues in the last release.
